hooks.name: vitana-pipeline-start
hooks.description: VTID-05275: every Kiro IDE session starts on the Vitana pipeline.

action.prompt: Load .kiro/steering/vitana-pipeline.md; run the queue (node scripts/collab/queue.mjs --repo <vitana-platform> --repo <vitana-v1>); resume any plan driver whose heartbeat (refs/heads/collab-driver/<slug>) is older than 45 minutes. Every owner task that results in a commit runs the pipeline end to end (.kiro/workflows/vitana-pipeline.workflow.json); the only owner stop is Gate 2 (plus an escalated sparring verdict).
